create_gaussian_2d_kernel: create a 2D Gaussian kernel tensor with a given radius and sigma value
generate_gaussian_heatmap_target: generate a 2D Gaussian heatmap by overlaying a kernel on an input heatmap at a center
compute_gaussian_radius: compute the Gaussian radius for a detection box size given a minimum IoU overlap threshold
extract_local_maximum_from_heatmap: extract local maximum pixels from a heatmap using max pooling with a configurable kernel
gather_features_by_index: gather features from a feature map at specified coordinate indices with optional masking
